questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{因为总体服从正态分布，所以} & & \frac{(n-1)S^2}{\sigma^2} \sim \chi^2(n-1). \\ & & & D\left[\frac{(n-1)S^2}{\sigma^2}\right] = 2(n-1), \quad D(S^2) = \frac{2\sigma^4}{n-1}. \\ & \text{由切比雪夫不等式及 } E(S^2) = \sigma^2, \text{有} & & 0 \leq P\{|S^2 - E(S^2)| \geq \varepsilon\} = P\{|S^2 - \sigma^2| \geq \varepsilon\} \leq \frac{1}{\varepsilon^2} D(S^2) = \frac{2\sigma^4}{\varepsilon^2(n-1)}. \\ & \text{所以，对任意给定的 } \varepsilon > 0, \text{总有} & & \lim_{n \to \infty} P\{|S^2 - \sigma^2| \geq \varepsilon\} = 0. \\ & \text{故 } S^2 \text{ 是 } \sigma^2 \text{ 的相合估计量.} \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{因为} \ E(\overline{X})&=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}E(X_{i})=p, \text{所以} \widehat{p}=\overline{X} \text{是} p \text{的无偏估计量}. \\ \text{又} & \quad D(\overline{X})=\frac{1}{n^{2}}\sum_{i=1}^{n}D(X_{i})=\frac{1}{n^{2}}\sum_{i=1}^{n}p(1-p)=\frac{p(1-p)}{n}. \\ \text{所以，由切比雪夫不等式，有} & \quad P\{\left|\widehat{p}-p\right|\geq\varepsilon\}=P\{\left|\overline{X}-p\right|\geq\varepsilon\}\leq\frac{1}{\varepsilon^{2}}D(\overline{X})=\frac{p(1-p)}{n\varepsilon^{2}}, \\ \text{从而对任意给定的}\varepsilon>0, \text{总有} & \quad \lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}P\{\left|\widehat{p}-p\right|\geq\varepsilon\}=0, \\ \text{故} \widehat{p}=\overline{X} \text{又是废品率} p \text{的一致估计量}. \\ & \quad \widehat{p}=\overline{X}+p(1-p), \widehat{p}=p, \widehat{p}=\overline{X}-p \text{均与未知参数} p \text{有关，所以都不是估计量}. \end{aligned}
